question: Which concerts had more singers performing than the average number of singers per concert?
reference_sql: WITH concert_counts AS (SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count FROM concert AS c LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name) SELECT concert_Name FROM concert_counts WHERE singer_count > (SELECT AVG(singer_count) FROM concert_counts)
candidate_sql:
WITH singer_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.concert_ID,
        c.concert_Name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
    FROM concert AS c
    LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
        ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
    GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
)
SELECT concert_Name
FROM singer_counts
WHERE singer_count > (SELECT AVG(singer_count) FROM singer_counts);
